subject: MemCompiler ScienceWorld evaluated-memory provenance in public Git history
observations: The initial public ScienceWorld runner stores output under ./output/scienceworld and points MEMCOMPILER_PATH at ./output/memcompiler.
The same initial public revision's .gitignore excludes *.db, *.db-journal, output*/, .db*/, chroma.log, *.log and *.zip.

The public main history begins after the paper's May 2026 arXiv versions, so current/initial-public defaults cannot be back-projected to the evaluated Table-3 run without an explicit historical bridge.

No versioned evaluated ScienceWorld memory-database snapshot is present in the observed initial public tree; the repository's ignore policy structurally prevents ordinary persisted DB/output artifacts from appearing in Git history.

inference.safe_claim: Searching the ordinary MemCompiler Git history for the exact evaluated ScienceWorld memory DB is not a promising continuation because the persisted DB/output forms used by the public runner are explicitly ignored. The unresolved provenance target should move to external public artifacts such as Hugging Face datasets/model-associated files, supplementary archives, project releases or a run manifest that binds memory-bank/candidate-pool digests to Table 3.
inference.forbidden_upgrade: Do not infer that the evaluated memory DB never existed, and do not attribute the initial-public runner defaults to Table 3 without a run bridge.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.note: This finding narrows public provenance search only; it does not claim quota-free reproducibility of the original model/evaluation.

exact_next_action: Do not repeat Git-history searches for ordinary MemCompiler DB/output files. Search public external artifact surfaces for a Table-3 run manifest or memory-bank/candidate-pool snapshot bound to the evaluated ScienceWorld model/source revision; if none is published, retain the fixed-candidate-pool claim only and continue seeking a different science-domain candidate-frozen intervention.
